sampleNodes.name: MC_FINDING_ChangeDetection_RAII
sampleNodes.desc: Change detection must use DerefMut-based RAII guard (Mut<T> wrapper), not manual dirty flags. Without it, direct &mut T access bypasses detection.

sampleNodes.name: MC_FINDING_AStar_FrameBudget
sampleNodes.desc: A* on 3D grid with 64-block radius = 262K nodes = ~26ms. Must cap search budget per frame and use hierarchical pathfinding.

sampleNodes.name: MC_FINDING_Event_1Frame_Latency
sampleNodes.desc: Event double-buffering introduces 1-frame latency.

sampleNodes.name: MC_FINDING_No_NetworkOwnership
sampleNodes.desc: ECS has no entity ownership model for P2P. Need NetworkAuthority component + Replicated marker.

sampleNodes.name: MC_FINDING_CRDT_Impractical
sampleNodes.desc: Full CRDTs per block = 16+ bytes/block = impractical. Use LWW with Lamport timestamps instead.

sampleNodes.name: MC_FINDING_EventQueue_NoCap
sampleNodes.desc: EventQueue has no capacity cap / backpressure.

sampleNodes.name: MC_FINDING_ChunkGen_NotPure
sampleNodes.desc: generate_chunk is a method on World. Must be a free function to enable Web Worker offloading.

sampleNodes.name: MC_FINDING_Query_Disjointness
sampleNodes.desc: Cannot enforce Query<&mut A> and Query<&A> disjointness at compile time.

sampleNodes.name: src-hlc-Hlc
sampleNodes.desc: 16-byte Hybrid Logical Clock timestamp combining wall-clock time, logical counter, and node_id for causal ordering.

sampleNodes.name: src-hlc-tick
sampleNodes.desc: Advances the HLC on a local event, updating wall time or incrementing counter before sending a message.

sampleNodes.name: src-hlc-recv
sampleNodes.desc: Merges a remote HLC into the local clock, preserving happens-before causality across nodes.

sampleNodes.name: src-hlc-to_bytes
sampleNodes.desc: Serializes the HLC to a 16-byte big-endian wire format for network transmission.

sampleNodes.name: src-hlc-from_bytes
sampleNodes.desc: Deserializes a 16-byte buffer back into an Hlc struct.

sampleNodes.name: src-lamport-Lamport
sampleNodes.desc: 12-byte Lamport timestamp (u64 counter + u32 node_id) for total ordering in LWW-Map conflict resolution.

sampleNodes.name: src-lamport-tick
sampleNodes.desc: Increments the Lamport counter on a local event and returns the new timestamp.

sampleNodes.name: src-lamport-recv
sampleNodes.desc: Updates the local Lamport counter to max(local, remote)+1 upon receiving a remote timestamp.
